author: OpenAI
description:
For more than 40 years, Tom and Lisa Perini have welcomed visitors to their ranch and restaurant in Buffalo Gap, Texas, just outside Abilene.

As new investment and AI infrastructure arrive in the region, they've seen firsthand how growth can create new opportunities for local businesses while raising important questions about preserving the character of rural communities.

In this conversation, the Perinis reflect on what makes their community special, why they believe small towns need opportunity to thrive, and how they think about balancing growth with the traditions and way of life they hope will endure for generations to come.
title: Life Near OpenAI's Stargate Project

author: OpenAI
description:
In November, @jamesbensonking will attempt to become the first person to cycle solo and unsupported from the edge of Antarctica to the South Pole, a journey that could take up to 60 days. But for James, the real challenge begins long before he sets foot or wheel on the ice.

With no existing blueprint to follow, James uses ChatGPT to build and refine his training in real time, bringing together multiple disciplines, logging ideas, and troubleshooting problems as they arise.

Follow James’ journey as he trains in the Icelandic highlands, where unpredictable weather and terrain offer a closer approximation of what he’ll face in Antarctica, and where ChatGPT becomes part of how he prepares, adapts, and keeps moving forward.
title: Training to cycle across Antarctica | with ChatGPT
